name: LERA 79th Annual Meeting
edition: 79th Annual Meeting (theme: Building a Better Future for Work)
deadline_note: General deadline for sessions and papers/posters. Other paper deadlines: LERA Competitive Papers (complete paper) 15 Dec 2026; LERA/AILR, LERA/ICJI and DCDC best student paper submissions 15 Jan 2027 (the page's deadline list also shows 'due 9/15/26 extended 10/15/26' for these).
submission_requirements: Session proposals with session abstract/description and participant details (75-minute sessions with 3-4 speaking roles); individual paper and poster proposals with abstract; LERA Competitive Papers require a complete paper (double-blind refereed)
registration_fee: Not stated; all participants are expected to register (and pay)
